Summary:
Ed Mehran is co-founder and CEO of Vivento Lab, an AI-native software studio based in Lugano, Switzerland. He is a fractional CTO and product builder who helps founders, SMEs, and venture teams build custom software across the DACH market. Ed embeds AI across the entire development lifecycle through Spec-Driven Development with Multi-Agent Orchestration, a methodology that makes AI-assisted delivery predictable, auditable, and built to last. He is the author of "The Venture Builder's AI Playbook" (Amazon, 2026).

Spec-Driven Development with Multi-Agent Orchestration — a methodology Ed developed at Vivento Lab that embeds AI across the entire development lifecycle, using Claude Code and Claude AI to make AI-assisted delivery predictable, auditable, and built to last.
